data.name: Hermine
data.gender_notes: Hermine is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek Hermē, meaning ‘terrible one, goddess of the sea’. In Greek mythology, Hermē is the goddess of the sea and is often depicted as a mermaid, half-woman, half-fish. The name Hermine carries the meaning “Sea goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hermine usually hope their child will grow to embody sea goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hermine total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: הרמינה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: הרמינה הוא שם נגזר מהמילה היוונית 'הרמונס' (Harmonia), שפירושה 'שלום' או 'שלמות'. השם קשור למושגים של אחדות והרמוניה, ויש לו קונוטציות רוחניות ופילוסופיות. בהקשר הנוצרי, השם עשוי להיות קשור למושג השלום והאחדות עם אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ερμινη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ερμινη προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'αρμονία' (Harmonia), που σημαίνει 'αρμονία', 'ενότητα' ή 'σύμφωνία'. Στην ελληνική μυθολογία, η Αρμονία ήταν κόρη του Αρη και της Αφροδίτης. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα μπορεί να συμβολίζει την πνευματική αρμονία και την ενότητα με τον Θεό.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hermine is of Greek origin and carries the rich cultural history of ancient Greece. It evokes the image of the goddess Hermē, a powerful deity associated with the sea, storms, and fertility. In a world where human beings relied heavily on the sea for their livelihoods, invoking the name of a sea goddess could be seen as a source of strength, protection, and good fortune. Today, the name Hermine can be seen as a connection to this rich cultural legacy and a reminder of the power and mystery of the sea.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hermine holds deep spiritual significance, as it is derived from the Greek goddess Hermē, a goddess of the sea and a symbol of power, strength, and creativity. In Christianity, the name Hermine can be seen as a reminder of God's power and majesty over the natural world. It can also be seen as a reminder of the spiritual power that lies within each of us, as we navigate the storms and challenges of life. Just as the sea can be both calming and tumultuous, the name Hermine can evoke a sense of both peace and power, inspiring us to tap into our inner strength and resilience.
